title: Commit before AI changes many files
why_it_matters: Git is your undo button when a change goes wrong.
explanation: Make a commit, or a branch, before letting AI touch several files. If the result breaks things, git restore or reset brings back your working version. Review changes with git diff before keeping them.
code:
git add -A
git commit -m "Checkpoint before AI refactor"
git switch -c ai-refactor
try_it: Make a checkpoint commit before your next AI-assisted change.
